text:
Nate: flagging OpenForge asking to list Aurora-7B. their rep says it's MIT-like and they want "redistribute without restriction" plus public downloadable checkpoints.
Ivy: MIT-like + downloadable = red flag for redistribution policy. need the exact license text and a contributor list.
Sam: also ask for ECCN/classification & country-of-origin for weights. downloads could trigger export checks.
Nate: pasted from their email: "Aurora-7B is provided under the Aurora Public License v1 (permits redistribution and commercial use, no attribution required)" — short blob, no CLA attached.
Priya: security note: require dataset manifest, SBOM for their runtime image, and pentest attestation if they want public listing.
Courtney: marketing asked if co-branded launch ok — won't greenlight without security & legal cleared. need 2 weeks min.
Sam: ops: if we allow downloads, we prefer to host quantized variants only. partner asked for full fp32 on our CDN for enterprise customers. that would increase bandwidth & risk.
Ivy: legally, hosting downloadable raw weights = redistribution. gating doesn't change that. ask for an addendum: attribution + no-relicensing + enterprise-only download clause.
Nate: OpenForge says they want permissive distribution to boost adoption. they offered joint blog & logo use.
Priya: propose compromise: public inference image + public listing for quantized runtimes; gated, contract-bound access to raw weights with signed enterprise contract, export signoff, and security attestation.
Sam: tech follow-up: gated downloads require dedicated buckets, signed-download workflow, and audit logs. estimate 3 days to provision after legal/partner docs.
Ivy: I'll draft a one-paragraph EULA overlay requiring attribution, prohibition on sublicensing, and requirement for contributor disclosures. Sam/Priya, can you add infra & security bullets?
Courtney: marketing timeline: we'll prep assets as soon as legal confirms the launch window. hold co-brand until we get attestation.
marketplace-bot: reminder: attach license, contributor list, dataset manifest, and security attestation to PART-999: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PART-999
Nate: action items: Nate to request full license + contributors + ECCN from OpenForge; Ivy to draft EULA addendum; Sam to scope infra gating; Priya to list security checklist. reconvene next Fri.
Nate: updating PART-999 after I hear back.
